conventions.today: Each row runs on clock_on(today). Default today is 2026-09-30 unless the row says otherwise. The acceptance journeys run on 2026-09-29; a row that names a journey states its own day.
conventions.regime: Rows dated after 2026-10-02 assume the pack's regime check was rerun and recheck_on moved past the row's today, unless the row is about staleness (g1.14b).
conventions.facts: A row's facts are either a full case (records, complete, confirmations) or a delta on a named base or journey: set sets <record>.<field>; unset removes a field; add appends records; remove drops records; complete and confirmations replace those keys. Base records are in bases below.
conventions.verdict: Verdicts are stated for the cap-gap part. The test clears every reason that is not about a petition, a capgap_i20, a trip in a cap-gap, or a cap-gap stage (by supplying those fields, as the journey tests do). It then asserts the state, that each listed reason is present, and that no other reason, question or item id starts with cap_gap, capgap, grace.after_cap_gap_outcome, current., h1b., or names a petition or capgap_i20 record.
conventions.stages: starts and ends are the stage's own days. ends_included says whether the ends day is inside the stage (true, false, or null for unsettled). reading true means a boundary rests on a reading. state is as engine_output (current, done, later, unknown).
conventions.ids: Ids end with the record id (programs.md 13.3). Judgement ids appear in verdict reasons and in the judgements array (contract C6). Conflicts appear as conflict:<check id>.<record>. Questions are <record>.<field>, complete.<kind>, or <record>.still_current (the reconfirm of contract C9).
conventions.provisions: Ids are the merged register of SPEC.md Appendix A.
conventions.shorthand: 'complete': 'all whole on D' means every record kind the pack declares is stated whole on D. complete_add adds statements to the base's. set_after_add sets fields after the add. case_facts sets case.facts. pack describes a pack state the test builds (a changed regime or recheck day). setting names an engine setting the test fixes.
